title: The Bishop's Charge
key_points: A bishop desires a good work, not a title, a platform, or a crown.
Character, not talent, is what Paul lists as qualifying a man for oversight.
An overseer feeds the flock with sound doctrine and also turns back the wolf.
True oversight raises up other elders instead of gathering people to himself.

verse.text: This is a true saying, If a man desire the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.

scene.caption: A crown of glory that fadeth not away.
scene.alt: A crown glows above a path winding through hills toward distant mountains, with an open Bible resting on the ground before it.

title: Setting Up a Church
key_points: A church begins in prayer and fasting, not with a building or a name.
The early church continued in doctrine, fellowship, breaking of bread, and prayers.
Elders are appointed only after time has tested them, with prayer and fasting.
Money is kept honest and in the light, seen to be so before men as well as God.

verse.text: And they continued stedfastly in the apostles' doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers.

scene.caption: Doctrine, fellowship, the breaking of bread, and prayers.
scene.alt: A temple stands beyond an open gate, with an open Bible, bread, and a chalice set together below a dove flying in a clear sky.

title: Holding a Miracle Event
key_points: A miracle event is won beforehand in secret prayer and fasting, not on the platform.
The Gospel is preached first, so a healed body is not gained while a soul is lost.
Faith is set on God alone; the minister points every eye away from himself.
When healing does not come, the power is never the problem — the line is searched for a break.

verse.text: Howbeit this kind goeth not out but by prayer and fasting.

scene.caption: Preach Him first, and give Him the glory last.
scene.alt: Golden light rays fall on a cross standing at the water's edge, with a dove flying above calm water.

title: Ministering in a Persecuted Region
key_points: Believers are sent as sheep among wolves, wise as serpents and harmless as doves.
The Holy Ghost, not a formula, decides whether a night is to flee or to stand.
Underground churches are kept small with many raised-up leaders and careful discretion.
Distance is no barrier to God; believing prayer reaches a brother in any cell.

verse.text: Behold, I send you forth as sheep in the midst of wolves: be ye therefore wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.

scene.caption: Wise as serpents, harmless as doves — joyful still.
scene.alt: A single candle burns beside a broken chain on the floor under a stormy sky, with one star breaking through the clouds.
